results.detail: Units 1-4 verified. Source: select ... from Gen_allowedinformationforfund with no WHERE (DTSX:2608). Multicast: Output 2 -> Get customers dead (Match -> delete), Output 3 -> Check if valid allow (No Match -> delete), Output 1 dangling. The validity query's active SQL is identical to the insert query; a whitespace-normalised diff differs only by one blank line. The 6 keys are agency, agent, fund (FUND_GUID), contact, POW_MAIN, account (DTSX:2463). Both deletes are 'delete Gen_allowedinformationforfundBase where Gen_allowedinformationforfundid = ?' on [CRM]. The double-delete note is labelled השערה. Unit 5 is wrong as stated: 'נמחקת ... כשייפוי הכוח כבר אינו במצב נוכחי (1)'. The actual rule is that a row is deleted when no row of the population query matches its 6 keys. If another current POA of the same account still yields the same agent/agency/contact/account/fund and the same POW_MAIN value (gen_powerofattorneymain is a GUID reference whose uniqueness per POA is not shown), the row is kept. The list in unit 5 is also presented as the set of triggers but omits others in the SQL: ac1.Gen_isContractDataSharing no longer 1, or the POA agent/agency no longer equal to the fund's (branch-2 rows); a change in the agent/agency resolution (gen_agents.gen_contactname / gen_agencie.gen_agencyname) or in the fund's contact/account; losing RowNum = 1. Fix: state the rule ('כשאין לה עוד התאמה בשישה המפתחות לשאילתת האוכלוסייה') and give the listed cases as examples.
wrongUnits: [5] 'כשייפוי הכוח כבר אינו במצב נוכחי (1)' - not sufficient for deletion; true trigger is absence of a 6-key match; enumeration omits branch-2 / resolution / RowNum triggers
